mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the venous valves was most worthwhile: the planned muscle-compression and flow-arrow comparison explains how return is helped and backflow resisted.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the thin-walled veins was comparatively straightforward; its picture added little beyond the already suggestive ingredient names.

surprise.text: The venous-return picture made the connection between contracting limb muscles and valve-assisted blood flow more explicit than the folds alone had suggested.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the vessel parts and their purposes were generally signposted. The term pericytes appeared in the basement-membrane description without explaining their role, though it was not needed to make the combination.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see how this vessel network connects to circulation, though this chapter's combinations were mostly predictable.
